_comment: M6 example configuration for the selected Assam study area.
TWO THINGS MUST BE SUPPLIED BEFORE THIS PRODUCES RESEARCH EVIDENCE:
1. study_area.boundary - replace the bounding box with the
2. real_data.reference - independent reference labels. Without them
the supervised stages are reported BLOCKED and the statistical
analysis runs alone. See docs/REAL_DATA_SETUP.md section 3.
real_data.ndvi_cube / rain_cube are filled in by `--prepare`, or set
by hand to Earth Engine exports already on disk.
This file is CONFIGURATION. No analytical function reads any of it;
changing the boundary changes WHERE the framework is applied, not HOW,
and is not evidence that it has been validated anywhere new.

reference.notes: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Satellite imagery supplies no degradation labels. Fill this in only with labels independent of the NDVI series; the loader rejects provenance indicating labels derived from this pipeline's own output.
